YOUTUBE PLAYABLE TEMPLATE, COMMON RULES. First script in index.html: <script src="https://www.youtube.com/game_api/v1"></script>. Wrap ytgame in a platform module with stubs so it runs without the SDK: firstFrameReady after first frame, gameReady once when Title accepts input, sendScore({value:int}) on Result, loadData/saveData JSON {"v":1,"best":0,"runs":0,"progress":{}}, onPause = freeze + silence + save, onResume = stay Paused, isAudioEnabled/onAudioEnabledChange drive master gain (no mute button), errors -> health.logError. No network, fonts, images, audio files, localStorage. All values in game_spec.json (stage units, seconds, palette tokens). Canvas fills window, stage 720x1280 fit contain, DPR cap 2, works 9:32 to 32:9, HUD anchored to screen edges + safe area: score top-left, timer top-center, pause top-right. Fixed 1/60 step, pools, no allocation in loop. States BOOT, TITLE, PLAY, PAUSED, RESULT. Input = actions from keys AND Pointer Events (tap, hold, swipe, drag, zones, joystick), same actions on keyboard and touch, buttons reachable by Enter/Space and Escape/P, touch-action none. Flat primitives, palette bg #121318 surface #1E2028 line #343846 text #F4F5F7 player #4CC9F0 hazard #F25F5C pickup #FFD166 positive #06D6A0 special #B388FF neutral #7D8597, system-ui font. Synth Web Audio sfx: uiTap start collect hit destroy action powerup win lose. Modules: spec platform viewport input audio save pool draw ui game world systems skins (skins read only look).

GAME: ARENA SURVIVOR (skeleton template, primitives only). Top-down arena larger than the screen: move in 8 directions, shoot chasing enemies, survive. Put in game_spec.json (next prompts add more):
{"meta":{"id":"arena-survivor","title":"Arena Survivor","version":"0.1.0","archetype":"survive-explore","scoreLabel":"XP"},"display":{"fit":"expand"},"input":{"aimDeadzone":0.25,"bindings":{"move":{"keys":{"up":["KeyW","ArrowUp"],"down":["KeyS","ArrowDown"],"left":["KeyA","ArrowLeft"],"right":["KeyD","ArrowRight"]},"pointer":"joystickLeft"},"aim":{"keys":{"up":["KeyI"],"down":["KeyK"],"left":["KeyJ"],"right":["KeyL"]},"pointer":["joystickRight","mouseAimRight"]}}},"rules":{"duration":180,"fireMode":"both","invulnerableTime":0.6,"knockback":260,"itemBlinkTime":3},"world":{"width":2400,"height":2400,"wallThickness":40,"floorGrid":160,"cameraLerp":8,"spawnMargin":80,"obstacles":[{"x":500,"y":500,"w":200,"h":200},{"x":1700,"y":500,"w":200,"h":200},{"x":500,"y":1700,"w":200,"h":200},{"x":1700,"y":1700,"w":200,"h":200}],"obstacleLook":{"shape":"rect","color":"neutral"},"scatterGems":40},"player":{"maxHp":100,"speed":420,"accel":3200,"magnetRadius":160,"pickupRadius":40,"look":{"shape":"circle","color":"player","size":60}},"weapon":{"fireInterval":0.28,"autoRange":420,"projectileSpeed":900,"projectileLife":1.1,"damage":1,"pierce":0,"look":{"shape":"circle","color":"player","size":20}},"entities":[{"id":"chaser","kind":"enemy","hp":2,"speed":160,"touchDamage":10,"xp":1,"look":{"shape":"triangle","color":"hazard","size":48}},{"id":"runner","kind":"enemy","hp":1,"speed":270,"touchDamage":8,"xp":1,"look":{"shape":"triangle","color":"hazard","size":36}},{"id":"tank","kind":"enemy","hp":8,"speed":90,"touchDamage":20,"xp":5,"look":{"shape":"rect","color":"hazard","size":80}},{"id":"gem","kind":"xp","magnetSpeed":700,"magnetRamp":0.15,"look":{"shape":"diamond","color":"pickup","size":24}},{"id":"heart","kind":"heal","heal":25,"dropChance":0.03,"life":20,"look":{"shape":"circle","color":"positive","size":32}},{"id":"magnet","kind":"magnet","dropChance":0.01,"life":20,"look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"special","size":40}}]}

WORLD AND CAMERA
Origin top-left, border walls of wallThickness, solid rects world.obstacles (x,y top-left) drawn with obstacleLook. Player starts at the center. Camera += (player - camera) * min(1, cameraLerp*dt), clamped so the view stays inside the world (centered if the view is larger).

INPUT
move and aim are vectors; key groups {up,down,left,right} give a normalized 8-direction vector. joystickLeft / joystickRight = floating joystick for pointers that START in that screen half; a pointer keeps its role until released (two thumbs work). mouseAimRight = mouse button held, started in the right half: aim = normalize(pointer world pos - player).

PLAYER
velocity moves toward move*speed by at most accel*dt. Colliders are circles of radius look.size/2. Pushed out of walls/obstacles (circle vs AABB), slides. Enemy contact: hp -= touchDamage, invulnerable rules.invulnerableTime (blink), knockback away from the enemy.

WEAPON (rules.fireMode)
Cooldown fireInterval. directional, or both with |aim| > input.aimDeadzone: fire along aim. auto, or both without aim: fire at the nearest enemy within autoRange, none = no shot. Projectiles: projectileSpeed, projectileLife, damage, pass through pierce enemies, die on walls/obstacles.

ENEMIES (entities with kind "enemy")
Steer toward the player at speed, collide with walls/obstacles. Hit = white flash; hp 0 = particles + destroy sound. For now spawn a random type every 1 s on the border of the view + world.spawnMargin, inside the walls, never in view.

ORDER per step: input, player, weapon, spawn, enemy, projectile, collision, pickup (next prompt), camera, end. hp <= 0 -> RESULT lose; rules.duration > 0 reached -> RESULT win.

Skins read only look; everything spawned comes from pools. Check: move with keys, mouse, touch; aim with IJKL, mouse, right thumb while moving; no errors.
